description: Fork of exp696 (1.4247 @ 100.7M, new SOTA across <150M tier). Single change: qkv_input_nap 4 -> 3. Reduces qk_lut rows-per-table 16 -> 8; per-layer qk params 3.15M -> 1.57M (saves 1.57M/L, -9.43M total). Model goes 100.67M -> ~91.2M (back under 100M). Tests qk capacity sensitivity: prior attention analysis suggests L0 collapses to self-attention regardless of NAP, so possibly NAP=3 is enough. Refs: exp696=1.4247 @ 100.7M (NAP=4 baseline), exp693=1.4379 @ 97.5M.
